## Test Case 152: E2E_ParentalControl_ManagedSites_Block_WebsiteKeyword_TrustedLANClient

## Objectives
Verify that the Wireless Gateway (WG) supports blocking of websites using keyword through Parental Control (Managed Sites) while allowing HTTP connectivity for trusted LAN clients.

## Test Case ID
TC_TDKB_E2E_474

## Test Type
Positive

## Test Environment
| Component |
|-----------|
| DUT - Device under test|
| LAN Client - Wired client |

## Test Configuration
| Parameter | Value |
|-----------|-------|
| Device.X_Comcast_com_ParentalControl.ManagedSites.Enable | true |
| Device.X_Comcast_com_ParentalControl.ManagedSites.BlockedSite.{i}.BlockMethod | Keyword |
| Device.X_Comcast_com_ParentalControl.ManagedSites.BlockedSite.{i}.Site | As per test configuration |
| Device.X_Comcast_com_ParentalControl.ManagedSites.BlockedSite.{i}.AlwaysBlock | true |
| Device.X_Comcast_com_ParentalControl.ManagedSites.TrustedUser.{i}.HostDescription | LanClient |
| Device.X_Comcast_com_ParentalControl.ManagedSites.TrustedUser.{i}.IPAddressType | IPv4 |
| Device.X_Comcast_com_ParentalControl.ManagedSites.TrustedUser.{i}.IPAddress | As per test configuration |
| Device.X_Comcast_com_ParentalControl.ManagedSites.TrustedUser.{i}.Trusted | true |

## Test Procedure and Expected Results
| Step Number | DUT | LAN Client | TDK Validation and Expected Results |
|---|------------------------------|------------------------------|------------------------------|
| 1 | <small>&nbsp;</small> | <small>Ensure the LAN client is connected and has an IP address assigned by the gateway DHCP.</small> | <small>&nbsp;</small> |
| 2 | <small>Get Device.X_Comcast_com_ParentalControl.ManagedSites.Enable using TR-181.</small> | <small>&nbsp;</small> | <small>Verify the current value is retrieved successfully. If the condition is met CONTINUE, else FAIL.</small> |
| 3 | <small>Set Device.X_Comcast_com_ParentalControl.ManagedSites.Enable = true using TR-181.</small> | <small>&nbsp;</small> | <small>Verify Device.X_Comcast_com_ParentalControl.ManagedSites.Enable is set to true. If the condition is met CONTINUE, else FAIL.</small> |
| 4 | <small>Add new entry to Device.X_Comcast_com_ParentalControl.ManagedSites.BlockedSite.</small> | <small>&nbsp;</small> | <small>Verify a new BlockedSite instance is created successfully and a valid instance index is returned. If the condition is met CONTINUE, else FAIL.</small> |
| 5 | <small>Set Device.X_Comcast_com_ParentalControl.ManagedSites.BlockedSite.{i}.BlockMethod, Device.X_Comcast_com_ParentalControl.ManagedSites.BlockedSite.{i}.Site, and Device.X_Comcast_com_ParentalControl.ManagedSites.BlockedSite.{i}.AlwaysBlock using TR-181.</small> | <small>&nbsp;</small> | <small>Verify BlockMethod, Site, and AlwaysBlock are set to the configured values. If the condition is met CONTINUE, else FAIL.</small> |
| 6 | <small>&nbsp;</small> | <small>Get the IP address of the LAN client.</small> | <small>Verify the LAN client IP address is retrieved successfully. If the condition is met CONTINUE, else FAIL.</small> |
| 7 | <small>Add new entry to Device.X_Comcast_com_ParentalControl.ManagedSites.TrustedUser.</small> | <small>&nbsp;</small> | <small>Verify a new TrustedUser instance is created successfully and a valid instance index is returned. If the condition is met CONTINUE, else FAIL.</small> |
| 8 | <small>Set Device.X_Comcast_com_ParentalControl.ManagedSites.TrustedUser.{i}.HostDescription, Device.X_Comcast_com_ParentalControl.ManagedSites.TrustedUser.{i}.IPAddressType, Device.X_Comcast_com_ParentalControl.ManagedSites.TrustedUser.{i}.IPAddress, and Device.X_Comcast_com_ParentalControl.ManagedSites.TrustedUser.{i}.Trusted using TR-181.</small> | <small>&nbsp;</small> | <small>Verify HostDescription, IPAddressType, IPAddress, and Trusted are set to the configured values. If the condition is met CONTINUE, else FAIL.</small> |
| 9 | <small>&nbsp;</small> | <small>Get the IP address of the LAN client.</small> | <small>Verify the LAN client IP address is retrieved successfully. If the condition is met CONTINUE, else FAIL.</small> |
| 10 | <small>Get Device.X_CISCO_COM_DeviceControl.LanManagementEntry.1.LanIPAddress using TR-181.</small> | <small>&nbsp;</small> | <small>Verify the Gateway LAN IP address is retrieved successfully. If the condition is met CONTINUE, else FAIL.</small> |
| 11 | <small>&nbsp;</small> | <small>&nbsp;</small> | <small>Verify the LAN client IP address is in the same DHCP range as the gateway IP. If the condition is met CONTINUE, else FAIL.</small> |
| 12 | <small>&nbsp;</small> | <small>Add a static route on the LAN client to route traffic for the website URL via the gateway IP.</small> | <small>Verify the static route is added successfully. If the condition is met CONTINUE, else FAIL.</small> |
| 13 | <small>&nbsp;</small> | <small>Attempt HTTP (wget) access from the trusted LAN client to the website URL containing the blocked keyword.</small> | <small>Verify that the trusted LAN client can successfully access the website URL containing the blocked keyword via HTTP. If the condition is met CONTINUE, else FAIL.</small> |
| 14 | <small>&nbsp;</small> | <small>Delete the static route added for the website URL from the LAN client.</small> | <small>Verify the static route is deleted successfully. If the condition is met CONTINUE, else FAIL.</small> |
| 15 | <small>Delete the added entry from Device.X_Comcast_com_ParentalControl.ManagedSites.TrustedUser.{i}.</small> | <small>&nbsp;</small> | <small>Verify the TrustedUser entry is deleted successfully. If the condition is met CONTINUE, else FAIL.</small> |
| 16 | <small>Delete the added entry from Device.X_Comcast_com_ParentalControl.ManagedSites.BlockedSite.{i}.</small> | <small>&nbsp;</small> | <small>Verify the BlockedSite entry is deleted successfully. If the condition is met CONTINUE, else FAIL.</small> |
| 17 | <small>Set Device.X_Comcast_com_ParentalControl.ManagedSites.Enable to revert it to its original value using TR-181.</small> | <small>&nbsp;</small> | <small>Verify Device.X_Comcast_com_ParentalControl.ManagedSites.Enable is reverted to its original value. If the condition is met PASS, else FAIL.</small> |


</details>

## Objectives

## Test Case ID
TC_TDKB_E2E_839

## Test Type
Negative

## Test Environment

| Component |
|-----------|
| DUT - Device under test|
| WLAN Client - Wireless client |

## Test Configuration

| Parameter | Value |
|-----------|-------|
| Device.WiFi.SSID.{i}.SSID | As per test configuration |
| Device.WiFi.AccessPoint.{i}.Security.KeyPassphrase | As per test configuration |
| Device.X_Comcast_com_ParentalControl.ManagedSites.Enable | true |
| Device.X_Comcast_com_ParentalControl.ManagedSites.BlockedSite.{i}.BlockMethod | URL |
| Device.X_Comcast_com_ParentalControl.ManagedSites.BlockedSite.{i}.Site | As per test configuration |
| Device.X_Comcast_com_ParentalControl.ManagedSites.BlockedSite.{i}.AlwaysBlock | true |

## Test Procedure and Expected Results

| Step Number | DUT | WLAN Client | TDK Validation and Expected Results |
|---|------------------------------|------------------------------|------------------------------|
| 1 | <small>Get Device.WiFi.SSID.{i}.SSID, Device.WiFi.AccessPoint.{i}.Security.KeyPassphrase and Device.X_Comcast_com_ParentalControl.ManagedSites.Enable using TR-181. Save the retrieved original values.</small> | <small>&nbsp;</small> | <small>If values are retrieved successfully CONTINUE, else FAIL.</small> |
| 2 | <small>Set Device.WiFi.SSID.{i}.SSID and Device.WiFi.AccessPoint.{i}.Security.KeyPassphrase using TR-181. Then set Device.X_Comcast_com_ParentalControl.ManagedSites.Enable = true using TR-181.</small> | <small>&nbsp;</small> | <small>If both SET operations are successful CONTINUE, else FAIL.</small> |
| 3 | <small>Get Device.WiFi.SSID.{i}.SSID, Device.WiFi.AccessPoint.{i}.Security.KeyPassphrase and Device.X_Comcast_com_ParentalControl.ManagedSites.Enable using TR-181.</small> | <small>&nbsp;</small> | <small>Verify the retrieved values match the values set in Step 2. If values match CONTINUE, else FAIL.</small> |
| 4 | <small>Add new entry to Device.X_Comcast_com_ParentalControl.ManagedSites.BlockedSite.</small> | <small>&nbsp;</small> | <small>Verify that a new instance is created in Device.X_Comcast_com_ParentalControl.ManagedSites.BlockedSite. and a valid instance number is returned. If new instance is created CONTINUE, else FAIL.</small> |
| 5 | <small>Set Device.X_Comcast_com_ParentalControl.ManagedSites.BlockedSite.{i}.BlockMethod = URL, Device.X_Comcast_com_ParentalControl.ManagedSites.BlockedSite.{i}.Site and Device.X_Comcast_com_ParentalControl.ManagedSites.BlockedSite.{i}.AlwaysBlock = true using TR-181.</small> | <small>&nbsp;</small> | <small>If SET is successful CONTINUE, else FAIL.</small> |
| 6 | <small>Get Device.X_Comcast_com_ParentalControl.ManagedSites.BlockedSite.{i}.BlockMethod, Device.X_Comcast_com_ParentalControl.ManagedSites.BlockedSite.{i}.Site and Device.X_Comcast_com_ParentalControl.ManagedSites.BlockedSite.{i}.AlwaysBlock using TR-181.</small> | <small>&nbsp;</small> | <small>Verify the retrieved values match the values set in Step 5. If values match CONTINUE, else FAIL.</small> |
| 7 | <small>&nbsp;</small> | <small>Connect to the WiFi SSID configured in Step 2.</small> | <small>Verify that the WLAN client connects to the WiFi SSID successfully. If connected CONTINUE, else FAIL.</small> |
| 8 | <small>&nbsp;</small> | <small>Get the IP address assigned to the WLAN interface.</small> | <small>Verify that an IP address is assigned to the WLAN client. If IP address is retrieved CONTINUE, else FAIL.</small> |
| 9 | <small>Get Device.X_CISCO_COM_DeviceControl.LanManagementEntry.1.LanIPAddress using TR-181.</small> | <small>&nbsp;</small> | <small>If value is retrieved successfully CONTINUE, else FAIL.</small> |
| 10 | <small>&nbsp;</small> | <small>&nbsp;</small> | <small>Verify that the WLAN client IP address is within the DHCP range of the gateway LAN IP. If WLAN IP is in the LAN DHCP range CONTINUE, else FAIL.</small> |
| 11 | <small>&nbsp;</small> | <small>Refresh the WiFi network on the WLAN client.</small> | <small>&nbsp;</small> |
| 12 | <small>&nbsp;</small> | <small>Add a static route on the WLAN client to reach the blocked URL via the gateway IP address.</small> | <small>Verify that the static route is added successfully. If added CONTINUE, else FAIL.</small> |
| 13 | <small>&nbsp;</small> | <small>Attempt HTTP access to the blocked URL using wget.</small> | <small>Verify that the HTTP connection to the blocked URL is blocked. If HTTP connection is blocked PASS, else FAIL.</small> |
| 14 | <small>&nbsp;</small> | <small>Delete the static route added in Step 12.</small> | <small>Verify that the static route is deleted successfully. If deleted CONTINUE, else FAIL.</small> |
| 15 | <small>&nbsp;</small> | <small>Disconnect from the WiFi SSID.</small> | <small>Verify that the WLAN client disconnects from the SSID successfully. If disconnected CONTINUE, else FAIL.</small> |
| 16 | <small>Delete the added Device.X_Comcast_com_ParentalControl.ManagedSites.BlockedSite.{i}. entry.</small> | <small>&nbsp;</small> | <small>Verify that the blocked site rule is deleted successfully. If deleted CONTINUE, else FAIL.</small> |
| 17 | <small>Revert Device.WiFi.SSID.{i}.SSID and Device.WiFi.AccessPoint.{i}.Security.KeyPassphrase to their original values saved in Step 1.</small> | <small>&nbsp;</small> | <small>If reverted CONTINUE, else FAIL.</small> |
| 18 | <small>Revert Device.X_Comcast_com_ParentalControl.ManagedSites.Enable to its original value saved in Step 1.</small> | <small>&nbsp;</small> | <small>If reverted PASS, else FAIL.</small> |


</details>
